findings.title: Delete and Pause menu items can never render in the new Grafana list view
findings.body: The list view now passes only `promRule` (`GrafanaRuleListItem` -> `RuleActionsButtons` V2 with no `rule`), so `rulerRule` is `undefined` in `AlertRuleMenu`. The Grafana prom abilities now make `canDelete` and `canPause` true for editable rules. The render conditions still need a ruler rule: Delete is gated by `canDelete && rulerRule` (line 165), and Pause by `canPause && rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)` (line 123). Both are false, so users lose Delete and Pause for every rule in the Grafana list (`GrafanaGroupLoader`, `FilterView`). The old `GrafanaRuleLoader` supplied the ruler rule, so this is a regression. `handleDelete` in V2 also ignores its arguments and only needs the identifier, so the `rulerRule` gate is unnecessary on this path. `MenuItemPauseRule` takes a ruler rule, so Pause needs either a prom-based variant or an explicit decision to drop it. No error is shown, the items just disappear.

findings.title: "Silence notifications" does nothing for rules rendered from promRule only
findings.body: `AlertRuleMenu` shows "Silence notifications" when `grafanaSilenceAbility` allows it, which is the case for Grafana alerting prom rules. Clicking it calls `setShowSilenceDrawer(true)`. The drawer only renders under `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule) && showSilenceDrawer` (line 104), and `rule` is `undefined` in the new list view. The menu item is visible and enabled but the click silently does nothing. The new `GrafanaGroupLoader` test asserts the Silence item is present but never clicks it, so this is not caught. `SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer` currently takes `rulerRule`; either give it a prom-rule path or hide the item until it has one.

findings.title: Skipped (undefined) Grafana prom rule still yields Duplicate = [supported, allowed], so cloud rules get a Duplicate item
findings.body: When called with `skipToken`, `useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities(undefined)` gets `loading: false` from `useIsGrafanaPromRuleEditable` (line 355). `MaybeSupported` is therefore `AlwaysSupported`, and `duplicateSupported` is `true` (line 313). `Duplicate` becomes `[true, hasPermission(grafana AlertingRuleCreate)]` (line 318). In `AlertRuleMenu`, `canDuplicate` ORs the ruler and Grafana results. So for any data-source (Mimir/Loki) rule, where the Grafana hook is called with `skipToken`, Duplicate is offered to any user with Grafana `alert.rules:create`. This applies even when the data source has no ruler (`isRulerAvailable` false) or the user lacks external write permission. Before this change that was gated by `useIsRuleEditable`. The unit tests hide it because `RulesTable.test` mocks both hooks. Make every ability `[false, false]` when `rule` is undefined, or return early before the memo. `useCanSilence` already does this for a missing rule.

findings.title: useAllAlertRuleAbilities lost its federated-rule-group check
findings.body: The old `useAllAlertRuleAbilities` computed `isFederated = isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)` and treated federated rules as immutable (no Update/Delete/Pause). It now delegates to `useAllRulerRuleAbilities`, which hard-codes `isFederated = false` (line 245, with a TODO), and the `rule.group` info is not passed. The legacy list (`RuleActionsButtons.tsx`, `RuleDetailsButtons.tsx`) still uses `useAllAlertRuleAbilities` and is still where federated Mimir groups are shown (`RulesGroup.tsx` shows a 'Federated' badge and blocks group editing). So users can now be offered Edit/Delete on rules in federated groups. Either compute federation from the combined rule in the deprecated wrapper and pass it in, or keep the old body for that hook.

findings.title: Rule link no longer carries returnTo
findings.body: The removed `GrafanaRuleListItem` built the href with `createRelativeUrl(..., { returnTo })` using `createReturnTo()`. The new one uses `createRelativeUrl(`/alerting/grafana/${uid}/view`)` only. `DataSourceRuleListItem.tsx:36` still passes `returnTo`. The view page reads `returnTo` via `useReturnTo` for its back button, so after this change, going from the Grafana list (including filtered/search URLs) to a rule loses the way back to the list state. Restore `returnTo`.

findings.title: Menu test locks in the missing Delete/Pause items and its comments are wrong
findings.body: The test grants Delete and Update permission and comments "all 4 menu actions should be available", then asserts exactly 4 menu items (Silence, Copy link, Duplicate, Export). With `AlertingRuleDelete` granted, a Delete item would be expected, so asserting `length === 4` encodes the regression where Delete and Pause are never rendered (see AlertRuleMenu.tsx:165). The test also never clicks Silence, which does nothing in this view. Assert Delete and Pause explicitly once they are restored, and add a click-through for Silence.

findings.title: Stale comment and variable name after ruler prefetch removal
findings.body: The comment says "preload ruler rules" and the variable is `cacheAndRulerPreload`, but the ruler prefetch dispatch was removed and only the prom cache is upserted now. Update the comment and rename the variable.

findings.title: Stray `// duplicate` comment
findings.body: `useIsGrafanaPromRuleEditable(rule); // duplicate` is a leftover and unclear. Remove it or say what is duplicated. The hook largely duplicates `useIsRuleEditable`'s Grafana branch.

contracts.action: Grafana list items now render from GrafanaPromRuleDTO only, with actions computed via useGrafanaPromRuleAbility(ies) instead of ruler data
contracts.equivalent_path: Old GrafanaRuleLoader/GrafanaRuleListItem (removed) fetched the ruler group and passed `rulerRule` to RuleActionsButtons V2; the legacy RuleActionsButtons.tsx still passes both rule and promRule
contracts.before_after: Before: Edit/Delete/Pause/Silence/Duplicate/Export all driven by rulerRule. After: abilities driven by promRule via folder permissions, but menu render gates and the silence drawer still require a ruler rule
contracts.visible_effect: Edit link, Duplicate, Export, Silence are shown. Delete and Pause are never shown. Silence is shown but its click does nothing
contracts.failure_mode: Silent: menu items are missing or inert with no error

contracts.action: useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities called with skipToken for non-Grafana rules
contracts.equivalent_path: useCanSilence returns [false,false] when rule is undefined; useIsRuleEditable returns not-editable for undefined rule
contracts.before_after: Before: only ruler abilities consulted, Duplicate gated by isRulerAvailable. After: OR with a Grafana ability set that reports Duplicate as supported for an undefined rule
contracts.visible_effect: Duplicate shown on cloud rules for users with Grafana create permission
contracts.failure_mode: Silent over-permissive UI, the backend would reject the clone later

contracts.action: Grafana list no longer fetches the ruler group (getGrafanaRulerGroup) and no longer shows Creating/Deleting operation items
contracts.before_after: Before: ruler/prom diff rendered Creating/Deleting placeholders and the load state waited on both. After: only prom response drives the list, errors fall to a single Alert when no prom response
contracts.visible_effect: Newly created or deleted rules appear or disappear when the prom poll catches up, with no intermediate state. Intended by the PR title and the removed tests
contracts.failure_mode: Prom fetch error shows the existing Alert, no partial rendering

summary: The change moves the Grafana alert list from ruler-driven to prom-rule-driven rendering. In the new list view, Delete and Pause never render. Silence is shown but its drawer never opens. Cloud rules can get a Duplicate item they previously did not. The legacy ability path no longer treats federated groups as immutable. Rule links lose `returnTo`. The new menu test asserts exactly four items, which locks in the missing Delete and Pause, and one comment in `prometheusGroupsGenerator.ts` is stale. I only read the code and did not run the tests.
